purpose: Pin geometry intervals quoted in layout/README.md to the committed GDS they claim to describe, so a prose number cannot drift from the artifact silently (#378, #391, #401). scripts/check_layout_geometry_claims.py asserts, per claim below, that readme_quote appears verbatim in layout/README.md (whitespace-normalised) AND that the GDS shape it cites still has bbox_um (1 nm tolerance). Where quote_values is present it additionally ties the quote's numerals to bbox_um (#414): editing README and the quote to the same wrong text no longer passes while bbox_um is unchanged. Since #419 a claim whose readme_quote spells an adjacent '<num>..<num>' pair must carry quote_values (coverage guard): deleting the field while the quote still spells an interval fails the check.

conventions.cell: top cell name; the GDS is layout/<cell>/<cell>.gds
conventions.subcell: name of the cell in the GDS hierarchy holding the shape (straps drawn by klt draw land in straps__straps; the ring-array gate pad in the capacitor ring's mos_array -- KLayout disambiguates the access ring's copy as mos_array$1, so a name swap on regeneration is itself a caught drift)
conventions.bbox_um: [left, bottom, right, top] of the shape
conventions.match: a claim passes when some raw shape OR some merged-polygon bbox of layer in subcell equals bbox_um within tolerance_um; the VB bands are single rectangles in straps__straps, so per-band bboxes survive only before the riser merge -- both candidate sets are measured
conventions.readme_quote: prose span in layout/README.md carrying the quoted numbers; editing the sentence away from this text fails the check by design
conventions.quote_values: optional per-claim map of bbox_um component names ('left', 'bottom', 'right', 'top') to indices into that claim's bbox_um array; when present, the readme_quote must spell each consecutive named pair as an adjacent '<num>..<num>' range (whitespace-padded, a '+ SYMBOL' or 'SYMBOL +' offset decoration tolerated, so '2.49 + DPAD .. 2.91 + DPAD' is the pair (2.49, 2.91) and 'DX+0.43..DX+0.85' is the pair (0.43, 0.85)) with both numerals equal to the indexed bbox_um components within tolerance_um (#414). Since #419 the field is mandatory wherever the quote demonstrably spells an interval: a claim whose readme_quote contains any '<num>..<num>' pair but omits this field fails the coverage guard, so only a quote that pins no interval may omit it
conventions.scope: pilot: only the VB-strap north bands and cap gate pads of the candidate-1 and candidate-3 bullets that drifted in #391/#401; every other README number stays unanchored until a per-claim extension lands here. Only layout/README.md is pinned; design-record notes elsewhere (e.g. rtl/pnr/) are build-stamped historical evidence and intentionally unpinned (#439)
